did: Every take on My data and the take library now says which videos home holds that play it, and whether deleting it makes home withdraw that video. The ask assumed the delete withdraws videos and names them in its receipt; it does neither, the render passes withdraw later, so I raised that before building. The badge now reads the very rule each pass withdraws by: the Rust Rounds and interview essays, the cards essays, and queued Studio videos. A fresh review caught one case where the badge would have said a delete was safe when it wasn't, a week shared after it was given, and that is fixed and tested.

calls.title: A queued Studio video shows as a use of the takes it names, though deleting one never withdraws it
options: List it, saying the video stays but loses the take
Leave Studio videos out of the badge
calls.why: The badge's job is that a used take never reads as unused, and nothing home does would withdraw a Studio video. The coordinator asked for this; it is C1383.
calls.undo: Drop the Studio read from file_host's take_uses, and the studio-video kind with it.

calls.title: A not-yet-given essay's opening take shows as used but not withdrawing
options: Show it as used, without withdrawing
calls.why: Deleting it makes home refuse that essay revision rather than withdraw the week, so a later revision can use the next older take (C1381).
calls.undo: Push the newest revision's opening takes as withdrawing in rust_essays::plays.

left: A delete that lands between the essay pass's two steps can withdraw a week the badge said it wouldn't; the window is milliseconds, the delete sheet re-reads at confirm, and the PR names it as a Tolerance.
The badge over-warns on a refused essay and on weeks of a subject the essay pass does not render for; that is the safe direction, so it was left.
